items.title: Maria Usbeck Announces New EP Canciones De Amor: Hear “Luz”
items.summary: Last year, The Ecuadorian-born, Brooklyn-based dream-pop artist Maria Usbeck returned from a long absence with Naturaleza, her first new album in six years. Yesterday, she announced plans to follow that record with Canciones De Amor, a new EP that she recorded with a team of musicians that includes Wild Nothing's Jack Tatum.
